title: Nanoscale {Ln(III)24Zn(II)6} Triangular Metalloring with Magnetic Refrigerant, Slow Magnetic Relaxation, and Fluorescent Properties

synthesis.procedure: Gd(ClO4)3·6H2O and Zn(OAc)2·2H2O were added to a solution of pyrazine-2-carboxylic acid (HL) in methanol/acetonitrile, followed by triethylamine. The colorless solution was stirred for 4 h and filtered. The filtrate was exposed to air for slow solvent evaporation; colorless needles formed in a few weeks.
synthesis.time: 4 h stirring; crystals obtained in a few weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution synthesis followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; filtrate exposed to air for slow evaporation, yielding colorless needles.
